titulo: Mundo: Mortalidad por enfermedades no transmisibles (30-70 a.), por países
fuente: Fuente: World Health Organization. Elaboración: Centro de Estudios POPULI · Carlos Aranda.
nota: Mortality from CVD, cancer, diabetes or CRD is the percent of 30-year-old-people who would die before their 70th birthday from any of cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, or chronic respiratory disease.
